title: Context note
description: A dated free-form note from the user, stored verbatim plus tags extracted by the context-log skill. Code uses tags only as hints; the weekly-decision skill reads the text.

applies_to.description: Last day the note concerns; equal to applies_from for a single day; null = ongoing from applies_from.

exercise_id.description: Set for injury, pain or baseline_reset notes that concern one exercise.

suggest_unusable.description: Hint for the weekly decision whether this note makes the week's weight trend unreliable.

follow_up_question.description: One short question if the note needs clarifying (e.g. which exercise, how many days).
